name: robotrade
description: Trading robot in Rust with Tauri

scripts.rust:clippy: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -W clippy::all -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::nursery -W clippy::cargo
scripts.quality:check: npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:clippy && npm run rust:test
scripts.quality:full: npm run quality:check && npm run rust:audit && npm run cpd:rust:check
scripts.quality: npm run quality:fix && npm run quality:check
scripts.validate: npm run quality:check && npm run rust:deny
scripts.validate:all: npm run quality:full && npm run rust:deny
scripts.ci: npm run validate:all && npm run rust:build

**/*.rs: sh -c 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -W clippy::all -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::nursery'
